verdict.rationale: Marqeta's evidence shows no user-configurable automation, workflow, or scheduled-job feature that runs autonomously in the background. Velocity and authorization controls are spend-enforcement rules, an adjacent feature. Webhooks, JIT funding (your own system makes the decisions) and the MCP server (for your own agents) are developer building blocks for constructing automation elsewhere. None of these is a first-party background-automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
